Thugs defraud victims of lakhs in separate incidents

In Rajgarh, a fraudster posing as a wholesale mobile trader from Indore took a large order and disappeared with an advance payment of ₹5.89 lakh. Separately, in Indore, an hospital employee was defrauded of ₹1.22 lakh through cyber fraud, with three mobile phones purchased in Delhi using their credit card.
